subtitle: From Molecular Biology to Algorithms and Computation
entryAssumptions: Algebra, functions, sets and discrete mathematical maturity
Basic probability, vectors, matrices and first-year calculus
depthPrinciple: Full scientific and technical depth with straightforward explanation. Useful abstraction is welcome: motivate it, define it, work through it, and show what it preserves and omits. No artificial university-level ceiling.

Evolutor.role: genomic computation theory, research and eventual runtime above both
